declarations.name: AuiImageViewer

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the viewer (region or dialog).

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: One or more images { src, alt, decorative?, caption?, thumbnail?, width?, height?, downloadName? }.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: inline renders into the host; lightbox renders a modal dialog opened with open().

inputs.name: aspectRatios
inputs.description: Crop presets { label, value: width / height | null }.

inputs.name: cropType
inputs.description: Blob type of the crop output.

inputs.name: cropQuality
inputs.description: Quality from 0 to 1 for JPEG and WebP output.

inputs.name: crossOrigin
inputs.description: CORS mode of the image request; needed to crop cross-origin images.

inputs.name: wheelZoom
inputs.description: When the wheel zooms: auto is Ctrl (or a pinch gesture) inline and always in the lightbox.

inputs.name: zoomStep
inputs.description: Zoom factor of one step, 1.05 to 4.

inputs.name: minZoom
inputs.description: Smallest zoom, 0.01 to 1 (fit may go lower for very large images).

inputs.name: showThumbnails
inputs.description: Show the thumbnail strip for two or more images.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of the counter, zoom level, and messages.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The shown image changed: { index, image }.

outputs.name: rotated
outputs.description: The image was rotated: { rotation, index }.

outputs.name: cropped
outputs.description: A crop was applied: { blob, canvas, rect, rotation, index, image }.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: An image failed to load, or a crop was refused (tainted canvas): { index, image, reason, message }.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Lightbox: open the dialog (optionally at an image). Inline: show that image.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Show an image (clamped), fitted and unrotated.

methods.name: setZoom
methods.description: Set the zoom, clamped to the zoom range.

methods.name: fit
methods.description: Fit the image to the view.

methods.name: rotate
methods.description: Rotate by a multiple of 90 degrees (default 90, clockwise).

methods.name: startCrop
methods.description: Enter crop mode with an aspect ratio (default: the first preset).

methods.name: crop
methods.description: Crop to the crop rectangle; resolves with the canvas and Blob and emits aui-crop.

accessibility.pattern: Inline: a labelled region with a toolbar (WAI-ARIA APG Toolbar), a focusable image stage, and thumbnail buttons with aria-current. Lightbox: the same content in a modal dialog (APG Dialog) that restores focus when it closes.

limitations: Rotation is in steps of 90 degrees.
Crop rectangles are axis aligned; there is no free rotation or perspective correction.
The download link uses the download attribute, which browsers ignore for cross-origin URLs (they open the image instead).
